featured.title: Mama's Kitchen
featured.tagline: Ordering page for a home catering side hustle
featured.description: Mama's Kitchen took orders through WhatsApp, calls, and Instagram DMs, with no visible menu or prices and messages getting lost in the scroll while she cooked. I built a single mobile-first page where customers can see today's menu, place an order in under a minute, and send it straight to her WhatsApp as a ready-to-send message.
featured.metric: 42 Online Orders in 6 Weeks — order-related messages down ~60%
